newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Wednesday as some contracts gained by late afternoon on buying by individual investors, traders said.
The benchmark March 1998 contract ended up 150 yen at 16,220 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 35,153 lots.

The market had a bearish sentiment at the opening, but some months attracted light buying from local investors later, traders said. They said Tokyo corn, unlike soybeans, is expected to remain bearish in the near term. "Local investors are building long positions in the soybean market while selling in the corn market," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.04 per bushel at 0905 GMT, against $3.06 at Tuesday's close.
The spot March CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.26-1/2 at 0905 GMT, down from $8.27-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
